title: Eligible, strong fit, evidence-backed concept
description: Food-security org with a specific, budgeted, evidence-backed concept within the award range and ample time before the deadline.

profile.name: Quinnipiac Valley Food Network (fictional)
profile.mission: Ensure every household in the Quinnipiac Valley has reliable access to healthy food.
evidence_assets: FY2025 delivery log: 18,400 meals delivered to 410 homebound seniors
2025 client survey (n=212): 87% reported eating more fresh produce
Partnership agreement with Hamden Senior Center for referrals

hard_criteria.source_quote: Organizations with annual budgets up to $5 million may apply.
Services must be delivered in Connecticut.

concept.title: Fresh Routes: weekly produce boxes for homebound seniors
concept.problem_statement: 410 homebound seniors on our delivery list receive shelf-stable meals but little fresh produce; our 2025 survey shows strong demand for produce.
concept.target_population: 150 homebound seniors in Hamden and North Haven referred by Hamden Senior Center
activities: Source produce from two local farms
Pack and deliver weekly produce boxes
outcomes: 150 seniors receive 45+ produce boxes each over 12 months
75% of participants report eating more fresh produce at 6 and 12 months (survey)
evidence_claims: We delivered 18,400 meals to 410 homebound seniors in FY2025
87% of surveyed clients reported eating more fresh produce
concept.budget_summary: Produce purchasing ($27k), driver stipends ($12k), packing supplies ($4k), coordinator 0.1 FTE ($7k); total $50k.
